query: Evaluate the third author of DOI_A against a PhD year 1 baseline.
setup: DOI_A: an open-access paper where the target is listed third but is a †-marked co-first author. Every OpenAlex/Crossref position field reads 'middle'.
expected_behavior: Reports the target as co-first on DOI_A, citing the full-text footnote
Does not describe the target as 'only a middle author' based on author_position
Marks co-first status of the target's paywalled papers as unknown, not as 'no'

query: Evaluate the first author of DOI_B.
setup: The target has a very common Chinese name. The OpenAlex ID attached to DOI_B merges 100+ works by other people; the target's own papers are split across several IDs. The target has an ORCID that is not linked from Crossref.
expected_behavior: Runs --diagnose-id or otherwise detects the merged ID and does not report its citation count or h-index
Finds the ORCID via name + affiliation search and confirms it by overlap with DOI_B
Builds the paper set from ORCID and/or a PI anchor, and reports the split IDs
Flags any paper not claimed on ORCID as weaker attribution

query: You found 6 papers but the person has 8. Recheck.
setup: Europe PMC intermittently returns 503. One missing item is a preprint claimed only on ORCID; another is from the target's previous institution, without the PI.
expected_behavior: Re-runs when fetch_error appears instead of reporting those papers as not open access
Finds the preprint through ORCID rather than by loosening institution filters
Adds the previous-institution paper explicitly and labels its attribution as unconfirmed if it is not on ORCID
